title: Prime Minister shares an article highlighting India’s coalition-building approach in a fractured world
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, today shared an article by Shri Harsh Goenka, Chairman of RPG Enterprises, highlighting how the Prime Minister’s foreign policy approach focuses on building coalitions in a fractured world while balancing ties with competing powers and advancing India’s strategic interests. Shri Modi said that the article highlights the New Delhi Declaration adopted at the BRICS Summit as an example of India’s coalition-building approach.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X:
“Shri @hvgoenka, Chairman of RPG Enterprises, writes that PM @narendramodi's foreign policy approach is about building coalitions in a fractured world, balancing ties with competing powers while advancing India's strategic interests.
He highlights the New Delhi Declaration adopted at the BRICS Summit as an example of India's coalition-building approach.”
